system.description:
This sleight stimulates the target’s nerve fibers, triggering intense pain throughout their body. They must succeed in a SOM x 3 Test to take an action; if they succeed they still suffer a −30 modifier (reduce this to −10 with an Excellent Success; ignore it with a critical). Each level of Pain Tolerance reduces the modifier by −10 and provides a +10 to the SOM x 3 Test.

Source: X-Risks, p. 178.
